description: Run your Lodgify vacation rentals: check availability, rates and quotes, create and confirm bookings, record check-ins, set door codes, make payment links and message guests.

lodgify_booking_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a Lodgify booking changes (its dates, guest, status or payments), with the booking as it is now. A new booking runs it too. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.created_at: When it was made, in UTC.
output.guest: The guest's name, email, phone and country.
output.id: The booking's number, for Get booking and the other booking steps.
output.rooms: The room types booked, with guest counts and door codes.
output.source: Where it came from: Manual, Airbnb, BookingCom, HomeAway and so on.
output.source_text: Where it came from, in words.
output.status: Its status: Booked, Tentative, Open or Declined.
output.thread_uid: The id of the conversation with the guest.
output.updated_at: When it last changed, in UTC.

parameters.description: Only run for bookings in this status after the change: Booked, Tentative, Open or Declined. Leave empty to run for any.
parameters.name: status

lodgify_new_booking_trigger.description: Runs for each new booking in Lodgify, from any channel (Airbnb, Booking.com, your website or added by hand), with its guest, dates, rooms and amounts. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.source_text: Where it came from, in words.
